provenance.method: Independent native curve vertices, geometric arrows/circle offsets, rational polygon spans and ordered per-plane Boolean line visits; no SyncTERM output or Atari execution.
provenance.native_initial: primary0x5aa5 XOR plane*0x1357, alternate0xa55a XOR plane*0x2468
provenance.native_foreground: Logical line pen10 retained across modes, physical9 masked to active depth; custom mask0xa531; app custom mask0xffff
provenance.application_foreground: Wire C1,10 chooses physical9 in low mode and active mask in medium/mono; recolour zero-background nonzero runs, XOR always active mask.
provenance.correction: Widen degree multiplication/angle arithmetic and normalize only trig lookup. Corrected fixtures use a common whole-turn shift to derive native positive-domain expected geometry with the identical sweep; no pre-table ROM reads or signed-word angle overflow.
provenance.host_bounds: Preserve native coarse signed rejection and clip phase; discard host/status writes after traversal and keep the serial128-point limit separate from129 generated vertices.
